meta_title: Novart Architects | Architects in Edavannapara, Malappuram
meta_description: Novart Architects designs new homes, renovations and interiors in Edavannapara, Malappuram, Kondotty, Areekode, Kozhikode and nearby Kerala towns.

hero.title: Homes built for Kerala's sun and monsoon
hero.text: We design new homes, renovations and interiors across Malappuram and Kozhikode, and stay with you from the first site visit to handover.

services.title: Architecture
services.text: New homes and workspaces planned around light, airflow and the way your family lives day to day.

services.title: Interiors
services.text: Materials, joinery and lighting designed together with the building, not added at the end.

services.title: Renovation
services.text: Older houses opened up, re-planned and refinished while keeping what still works.

services.title: Planning and approvals
services.text: Site studies, feasibility and permit drawings so you know what your plot allows before you build.

services.title: Project management
services.text: Contractors, schedules and site visits coordinated so the finished house matches the drawings.

process.title: Brief
process.text: We visit the site and learn your budget, your plot and how you want to live.

process.title: Shape
process.text: Plans, massing and material direction, reviewed with you in drawings and 3D.

process.title: Develop
process.text: Working drawings, structure, services and approvals, ready for construction.

process.title: Deliver
process.text: Regular site supervision until handover, so details are built as drawn.

studio.title: Design that starts with the site
text: Novart designs around climate, proportion, material durability and the everyday routines that make a building feel settled over time.
Deep eaves, cross-ventilation and shaded courtyards are not decoration in Kerala. They are how a house stays comfortable through April heat and June rain.

contact.title: Tell us about your plot
contact.text: Send the location, plot size and a few photos on WhatsApp, or call the studio to arrange a site visit.
